title: Pin the marketing website to the Python-era tarball and vendor the wiki publisher
description:
## Plan step 4 (private repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web, separate PR reviewed by the owner)
The website depends on the unpinned main tarball of Chatticus and its prebuild plus CI plus deploy-marketing-production run pip install -e node_modules/chatticus/python[wiki] and behave. python/ is deleted on develop, so the merge would break the next website build. Pin the dependency to the exact Python-era tarball (e68b5f4f), port or vendor wiki_publish (anthus-markus) into the website repo, drop the pip install and behave step, then return the dependency to main. The UI kit exports map is compatible.
## Decision: D3.
## Acceptance
- Website build and deploy succeed with the pin before the develop-to-main merge.
- After vendoring, the website builds against main with no python/ in the tarball.
- Agents do not merge website PRs.
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed; owner decisions are in the 'Decisions needed from the owner' ticket.
